entities.summary: Amiran Papinashvili is a Georgian judoka. He won gold medal in 2013 European Judo Championships, silver in 2014 European Judo Championships and bronze in 2012 European Judo Championships. He also competed for Georgia at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
